title: DS08 Sentinel-2 Annotation Schema
description: Formal JSON Schema for DS08 real Sentinel-2 Level-2A optical fire and thermal source region annotations (Stage 8.9).

chip_id.description: Identifier of the chip (e.g. PILOT_01_NORTH, PILOT_04_NORTH_REPLACEMENT).

annotation_version.description: Version of the annotation specification (e.g. v1.0).

chip_annotation_status.description: High-level chip observation status. NO_VISIBLE_TARGET indicates image was clear but no target was identified. UNRESOLVED indicates evidence was insufficient.

annotations.description: List of independent source region or object annotations within the chip.

annotation_id.description: Unique identifier for this annotation bounding box.

class_id.description: Class identifier: 1=Industrial Fire, 2=Forest Fire, 3=Agricultural Fire, 4=Other Thermal Source, 0=UNRESOLVED.

class_name.description: Assigned target class. UNRESOLVED is used when visual evidence is insufficient or ambiguous.

bbox.description: Bounding box coordinates in 512x512 pixel space.

x_min.description: Left column index in pixel coordinates (0 <= x_min < 512).

y_min.description: Top row index in pixel coordinates (0 <= y_min < 512).

x_max.description: Right column index in pixel coordinates (x_min < x_max <= 512).

y_max.description: Bottom row index in pixel coordinates (y_min < y_max <= 512).

geometry_confidence.description: Confidence in the spatial extent and boundary of the bounding box.

source_class_confidence.description: Confidence in the assigned fire/thermal source class.

visibility_status.description: Atmospheric/cloud obstruction status over the target region. HEAVILY_OBSCURED mandates class_name=UNRESOLVED.

visual_evidence.description: List of observable visual evidence tags supporting the annotation.

firms_relationship.description: Spatial relationship between the associated FIRMS thermal point and this bounding box.

annotator_id.description: Identifier of the annotator who created this record.

context_metadata.description: Contextual metadata stored strictly separately from ground-truth visual annotations.

firms_pixel_coord.description: Projected pixel coordinates (row, col) of FIRMS point on the 512x512 grid.

distance_to_nearest_infrastructure_m.description: Proximity to industrial infrastructure in meters (contextual only; does not determine class).

temporal_difference_hours.description: Time difference in hours between FIRMS detection and Sentinel-2 acquisition.

cloud_cover_pct.description: Scene-level cloud cover percentage from metadata.

authoritative_bands.description: Authoritative 5-band set. B08 is strictly excluded; NDVI is unavailable.

data_provenance.description: Source dataset provenance and pipeline audit tracking.
